digest.component_or_area: lock acquisition and release across enrichment drain, compaction trigger, and GC trigger
propositions: Three independent implementations of the O_EXCL-create stamped-file lock loop exist in enrich_drain.py, compact_trigger.py, and gc_trigger.py, each acquiring with stale reclamation and releasing, but with inconsistent semantics

The enrich_drain release wraps close and unlink in a single try block, causing the lock file to leak until the 3600 s ceiling if close raises; compact_trigger and gc_trigger use two independent try blocks ensuring unlink always runs

Extract the lock acquisition and release logic into a shared src/rebar/_store/stamped_lock.py module with stamped_file_lock and release_stamped_lock functions, using the two-independent-try form for release
The drain's stamp-failure WARNING and holder naming via _describe_drain_lock_holder callback must be preserved and adopted by the other two workers as a logging superset
Directory creation mechanisms differ across the three callers and must remain with them; the shared helper takes a resolved path and owns no directory creation
The guard criterion keying on 'os.O_CREAT ∧ stamped_file_is_stale' must correctly match all three copies while excluding unrelated O_EXCL uses and the diagnostic reader in doctor_locks
